attackers_goals: Surround recording or video capture in the workplace may leak corporate data. Surround recording or video capture of the user space can expose them to potential risks as worker extortion, sextortion, etc.
description: An unpopular process accessed the microphone on the host, the process can abuse this device.
investigative_actions: Check if the application that registered in the Microsoft privacy settings (ConsentStore in registry) is legitimate. Check if the user was aware of the use of the device.
name: An unpopular process accessed the microphone on the host
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
